exact_unresolved_scr554_binding_slots.purpose: Prove the upstream contract being bound is the accepted SCR554 adjudication rather than a guessed or stale authority snapshot.
Define exactly what EXACT_V554_F1_REF resolves to and how its schema/authority integrity is verified.
Define exact canonical V554 F1 equality so one-F1-per-route and different-F1-different-route can be verified without label heuristics.
Prove the referenced F1 is the exact accepted positive structural-mediation input rather than merely a structurally related object.
Define exactly what the canonical basis identity behind the F1 resolves to for M2 replay/checksum.
Define exact B1 identity/equality without guessing source/basis fields or precedence keys.
Prove which canonical accepted basis owns/produces the F1 and prevent ambiguous or duplicate basis attachment at the V554->V555 seam.
Make the accepted F1/B1 interpretation historically replayable under the exact V554 authority/rule/signature that produced it.

anti_guess_law.rule: The M2 binder maps the accepted SCR554 identity/reference contract into the already-frozen V555 EXACT_V554_F1_REF seam. No guessed sibling schema becomes authority.

m2_binding_algorithm: Verify accepted SCR554 return head/result token and exact immutable contract artifacts.
Bind the accepted canonical F1 reference schema/identity/equality law to V555 EXACT_V554_F1_REF.
Bind the accepted canonical B1 identity and exact F1<->B1 relation for upstream replay/seam verification.
Verify the referenced F1 carries the exact accepted positive structural-mediation use permission/state required by the governed V555 route rule.
Verify one and only one canonical F1 is consumed by each V555 route identity.
Verify different canonical F1 identities cannot collapse to one V555 route even when downstream visible bindings coincide.
Verify inherited V554 F2 remains exact-reference-only and is not re-owned during seam binding.
Re-run H555-037/H555-038 plus identity/replay hostiles against the bound sibling contract.
If no contradiction exists, mark M2 seam passed and permit SCR555_EXACT_CONTRACT_CLOSED without reopening other V555 holdings.

normal_success_transition.precondition: All eight binding slots are supplied by an accepted SCR554 contract and all M2 checks pass.
